title: Fumipoka — Project Journal
shortDescription: Leave a note where you stopped and pick up your project later.
fullDescription:
Create a project with a name, then save a short note about where you stopped. Return to your latest save point when you’re ready to continue.

Keep links and supported attachments in the Library. Save a private copy of documents and images you choose to import. Add the Continue project widget for quick access to your work.

Core features work offline and require no account. There are no ads or subscriptions. Exported backups are unencrypted and may be stored by the Android document provider you choose.
